title: A new second-order consistent splitting scheme for the Natural Convection equations
summary: A novel second-order consistent splitting scheme is proposed for the natural convection equations. The scheme is constructed using Taylor expansions about the time level $t^{n+k}$, where $k$ is a parameter to be determined. It is proved to be stable for all $k>4$, with the present study focusing primarily on the case $k=5$. Compared with the conventional splitting scheme based on Taylor expansions about $t^{n+1}$, the proposed scheme exhibits improved stability.
